exposure: Stepping Stone' culturally specific web-based intervention (4-week duration)
outcome: parents' knowledge of adolescent's mental health
communication and conflict management skills of parents
cohort: The study included 47 parents in the intervention group and 46 parents in the attention control group, all of whom were parents of adolescents aged 11 to 16 years in Korea.
finding: The 'Stepping Stone' culturally specific web-based intervention was found to be feasible and well-accepted by parents of adolescents.
